annotations.text: Matching the voice bridge client: #0e1113 ground, #e8e6e3 text, #8a9199 dim, #22282c rules, #4ec9a7 live. 10px controls, 14px bubbles, system-ui.

Two screens now. Review folded into the right-hand column of the first, so what it may say is visible while you write it. The report arrives on the call screen when the call ends — the transcript stays beneath it.
